facts.activity_file: gas testing before and during hot work

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident during an intrusive maintenance task on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on P-3222 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically gas testing before and during hot work. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 21 December 2020 a potential incident was recorded on P-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
